name: tcp_tuning

sysctl_config.rationale: The safeguard writes Linux TCP kernel settings.

storage.rationale: Linux-only system configuration is verified by the safeguard file check.

description: Optimize TCP stack parameters for reliable connectivity (PMTU probing, ECN, base MSS)

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.evidence: The macOS TCP provider is not wired into this safeguard yet; the host mechanism is the sysctl network-tuning surface.

windows.evidence: The Windows TCP provider is not wired into this safeguard yet; the host mechanism is the netsh interface tcp surface.
